title: frametrail:attributes of type "audio"
description: Audio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL. An audio overlay can play along with the video while it is shown (autoPlay). This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "audio". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

autoPlay.description: Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active.
